nary_nodes.label: Sophia Laforteza steps away from Katseye
evidence: Katseye vocalist Sophia Laforteza has announced she will temporarily step away from the popular girl group over mental health concerns.

Laforteza wrote separately on Instagram: "Making this decision wasn't easy, but I'm learning that health has to come first. I'm realising that if I don't take care of my mind and body now, I won't be able to keep doing what I love the most for so long."

nary_nodes.label: Manon Bannerman takes a break
evidence: The label announced in February that Katseye member Bannerman would take a temporary break to focus on her health and wellbeing, as well.
The 23-year-old Swiss singer told fans she was "healthy" and "taking care of myself".
